name: session-relay
description: Relays finished plans from a planning session to a building session, and change summaries from the building session to a review session.

role.title: This session's role
role.description: planner sends plans to the builder; builder sends change summaries to the reviewer; reviewer only receives.

registry.title: Registry file
registry.description: Shared file where the three sessions record their ids, relative to the working directory or absolute. Use the same file in all three sessions.
